notes.title: logik Checklist - Finishing Up For Early Access
notes.content:
Heya Puzzlers!

Wanted to share with you guys the 5 Things on the logik Checklist before Early Access Release!

(Not In Order) The List Goes:

1) Create 4 Challenge Levels and Implement the Achievements for Them.
2) Code the Soundtrack to be Continuous (Don't Destroy On Load).
3) Make Credits
4) Add Button Sound Effects
5) Test, Test, Test! -- Especially The Achievements!

------------

I sadly haven't had much time to work on logik lately do to my busy schedule. I will continue to work on this and will update you guys on the progress made!

Thanks for the support ːsteamhappyː,

thisGameDev

notes.title: The Vote's In! logik Will Be Early Access!
notes.content:
heya puzzlers and gamers!

the vote is finally over! the decision on whether logik should be Early Access or not has been made!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/siqsdxL.png[/img]

The Majority of votes were in favor of logik being Early Access! logik isn't fully ready yet for Early Access release, but will be in the near future! Thank you for voting, and this is exciting news!

Keep puzzlin' and gamin'! Look out for updates in the near future about logik and E.A. release!

From,

thisGameDev

notes.title: Vote: Should logik be Early Access or Not? logik - Development Update
notes.content:
Heya Fellow Puzzlers :)

Wanted to let you know that logik is relatively close to being done (at least for the first version of the game). I have been very busy lately and haven't had as much time as I would like to work on this game.

I wanted to ask you guys: would you like logik to be an early access game that is updated regularly, or not? Please vote in this google form, it would be much appreciated: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSek_aJWu4QpP0g42SS7jd73MsBkGPkojzrbUxuFXniQn4Gscg/viewform?usp=sf_link]logik Google Form[/url] -- this poll [i]will[/i] close on October 9th, 2022 (the Google Form will still be active, but I won't be counting any more votes towards the final decision).

Thanks & Please Vote with the Google Form Above (just click on "logik Google Form" and it'll take you there)!

All the best and keep puzzling!

From,

thisGameDev

notes.title: Post Next Fest - An Update on logik
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hello All![/h3][/b]

You may know this past week was Steam's Summer Next Fest, and logik was in it!

I would like to say that it was a huge success for logik! Thank you for all of the support and wishlists for my upcoming game, logik! It's my first commercial release on Steam and the number of wishlists was increased dramatically!

Thank you [b]so very much[/b] for all of the support and wishlisting of my game! ːsteamthumbsupː

Keep being awesome, and I will start to update my progress in making logik as announcements on the steam community.
